usual_baseline: HDAT is uncommon, 1.2–9% of patients [3319][3080][3166], but monitoring is poor. HDAT forms 0% [3166][3657], 1/378 [3572]. Monitoring compliance 26% [3591]. Quarterly bloods and ECG 8–23% [3114]; ECG after dose increase 36% [3080]; cardiovascular check before HDAT 41% [3349]. Prolactin and ECG are most often missed [3591].
fix_that_works: Electronic flag and active therapy plan that orders tests and books appointments: monitoring 26% to 58%, flags and plans 100% [3591]. A local HDAT register with biannual review: average compliance 60.6% to 77%, HDAT form 0% to 67%, and HDAT stopped in 50% of the baseline cohort [3657]. Feedback to prescribers raised quarterly bloods to about 50–60% [3114].
fix_that_fails: With no intervention, a second cycle got worse: exceeding BNF maxima 1% to 2.9%, polypharmacy 5.6% to 10.4%, HDAT forms 0.62% [3572]. After the register, blood tests and ECG fell by 25.4% and 75.1% relative [3657]. Quarterly ECG stayed about 40% [3114].
consultant_advice: The finding is always the same: forms and ECGs are missing. Only system fixes, a register or EHR flag, moved the numbers. More useful: audit whether HDAT is reviewed and stopped, since half the cohort came off after review [3657], and track ECG and prolactin specifically.
